app.title: Tyr & Ko
app.documentTitle: Tyr & Ko — Free Colour Code-Breaking Game

common.showTimerDescription: The clock still runs for high scores.
common.highScoresDescription: Saves your best wins under your name.
common.hintsDescription: Tyr points out what your clues prove so far.
common.dailyDescription: Shows one code a day, the same for everyone.
common.minimalTextDescription: Icons instead of words. The ? button still explains the rules.
common.autoSubmitDescription: Checks your guess as soon as the last peg is in.
common.soundDescription: Clicks for pegs, plus a tune when you win or lose.
common.appearanceDescription: The board keeps its theme, and printing is always light.
common.pinkBullDescription: Show right-spot pegs in pink instead of black.
common.swapColorsDescription: After each guess, the computer may switch to any code that still fits your pegs. The pegs never lie. Before your first guess, it changes this game too. After that, it waits for your next game.
common.pegStyleDescription: Shapes help tell colours apart. Shape only is a harder way to play.

game.startHintDistinct_other: Pick {{count}} different colours, then press Check.
game.giveUpDescription: The secret code will be shown.
game.abandonDescription: Your guesses on this board will be lost.

help.description: Crack the secret colour code before you run out of guesses.
help.step1: Tap colours to fill the empty row.
help.stepRemove: Tap a colour in the row to take it out.
help.step2: Press Check to try your guess.
help.step3: Each coloured peg is a bull: right colour, right spot.
help.step4: Each white peg is a cow: right colour, wrong spot.
help.step5: The coloured and white pegs don't say which spot they mean. That's the puzzle!
help.step6: Crack the code before you run out of rows.
help.stepBull: Stuck? Tap the bull on the shield for a hint.

result.lost: Out of guesses — code revealed above
result.gaveUp: You gave up — code revealed above

daily.description: One code a day, the same for everyone. Classic rules, one try.

quips.hello: Moo moo… let's play a game!
quips.names: I'm Tyr. The cow is Ko. We guard the code.
quips.spots: Bulls sit in the right spot. Cows just wander about.
quips.memory: I never forget a colour. Well, almost never.
quips.chewing: Chewing on a tricky code. Give me a minute.
quips.history: Bulls and Cows was a pencil-and-paper game long before pegs.
quips.secret: Psst… I'm not allowed to tell you the code.
quips.everyGuess: Every guess tells you something, even a bad one.
quips.difficulties: Easy has no repeats. Hard has eight colours. Classic is in between.
quips.takeTime: Take your time. The pegs aren't going anywhere.
quips.koCounting: Ko says hi. She's busy counting cows.
quips.favourite: I like the yellow pegs best. Don't tell the others.
quips.seeRed: Bulls don't really mind red. It's the waving that annoys us.
quips.goodGuess: A good guess is never wasted.
quips.hooves: I'd play too, but my hooves are too big for the pegs.
quips.soundsEasy: A few colours, a few spots. Sounds easy, right?
quips.danish: Tyr means bull in Danish. Ko means cow.

tips.differentColors: Start with different colours to find out which ones are in.
tips.noMatches: No bulls and no cows? Then none of those colours are in the code.
tips.keepColors: Keep the colours you know, and move them to new spots.
tips.oneChange: Change one thing at a time to see what it does.
tips.fitClues: Only try codes that fit all your clues so far.
tips.doubles: In Classic and Hard, colours can repeat. Watch out for doubles!
tips.countPegs: Bulls plus cows tells you how many of your colours are in the code.
tips.newColor: Stuck? Try a colour you haven't used yet.

won.impressed: Nice work. Even Ko is impressed.

lost.close: So close! Want to try again?
lost.nextOne: The code won this time. The next one is yours.
lost.lesson: Every lost game teaches a new trick.

hints.atLeast_one: The code has at least {{count}} {{color}} peg.
hints.atLeast_other: The code has at least {{count}} {{color}} pegs.
hints.atMostOne: No more than one {{color}} peg in the code.
hints.noRepeats: No colour appears twice in this code.
hints.hasRepeat: Some colour appears more than once.
hints.rowHasAbsent: Your row has {{color}}, but the code has none.
hints.rowRepeat: Your row has more than one {{color}}, but no colour appears twice in this code.
hints.rowSlotWrong: Your row has {{color}} in slot {{slot}}. It can't go there.
hints.rowConflict: This row doesn't fit your clue in row {{row}}.
hints.rowNoFit: These pegs don't fit your clues together. Change one.
hints.rowFits: This row fits all your clues. It could be the code!
hints.rowFitsSoFar: So far, your row fits all your clues.
hints.codesLeft_one: {{count, number}} code still fits your clues.
hints.codesLeft_other: {{count, number}} codes still fit your clues.
hints.oneLeft: Only one code fits now. You can crack it!

bull.noClues: Hmm, not enough clues yet. Make another guess!

calm.breatheSlowly: Breathe in slowly… and out. The pegs can wait.
calm.thinkFirst: Take a moment to think before you place a peg.
calm.shoulders: Shoulders down, jaw loose. Now look again.
calm.closeEyes: Close your eyes for one breath. Then read your clues.
calm.feet: Feel your feet on the floor. Nothing here is in a hurry.
calm.stretch: Roll your shoulders, stretch your neck. Bulls do it too.
calm.noRush: You have all day: the code stays until midnight.

daily.oneTry: One try a day. Your board is saved in this browser, so reloading won't give you another go.
daily.sameCode: Everyone gets the same code today. Share your result and compare.
daily.streak: Win days in a row for a streak. A missed day or a loss starts it over.
daily.noHints: No hints on the daily code. Today it's you and your clues.
daily.nextCode: A new code comes at midnight, your time. That's {{time}}.
daily.seed: Today's code isn't stored anywhere. It's worked out from the date (day #{{number, number}}), so every device gets the same one.
daily.rules: Today's rules are Classic ({{details}}). Colours can repeat, and you get {{guesses, number}} guesses.

facts.knuth: In 1977, Donald Knuth showed any Classic code can be cracked in five guesses or fewer.
facts.perfectAverage: With perfect play, a Classic code takes about 4.3 guesses on average.

stats.wins: Daily codes won: {{won, number}} of {{played, number}}.
stats.averageWin: Average guesses per daily win: {{guesses, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}}.
stats.bestStreak: Your best streak: {{days, number}} in a row.
